{"id":1849322518,"question_id":3843,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1765115737,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"3 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1849322518/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Partition Array into Two Equal Product Subsets","memory":"23.9 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int parts = 0;\n    void byrec(vector<int>&nums , long long target , long long prod , int i)\n    {\n        if(i >= nums.size() or prod > target) return;\n        if(prod == target)\n        {\n            parts++;\n            return;\n        }\n        //include\n        byrec(nums , target , prod * nums[i] , i+1);\n        //exclude\n        byrec(nums , target , prod , i+1);\n    }\n    bool checkEqualPartitions(vector<int>& nums, long long target) {\n        __int128 need = (__int128)target * target;\n\n        for(auto num : nums)\n        {\n            if(need % num != 0) return false;\n            need /= num;\n        }\n\n        if(need != 1) return false;\n\n        byrec(nums , target , 1LL , 0);\n        return (parts >= 1);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"partition-array-into-two-equal-product-subsets","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1263}
